text:
http_host
Description
Specifies the value in the
Host:
header of the HTTP request. This
is a BIG-IP version 4.X variable, provided for backward-compatibility.
You can use the equivalent 9.X command
HTTP::host
instead.
Syntax
http_host
http_host
Specifies the value in the
Host:
header of the HTTP request.
